caption:

topic: Tip: stir your stain, do not shake it
caption:
Shaking a tin of stain puts air bubbles into the finish, and they show up as tiny marks on the wood. Stir slowly from the bottom until the colour is even, and stir again every few minutes while you work, because pigment settles. Same shade from the first piece to the last. Tag a carpenter who still shakes the tin. Need advice? Call us on 63644 44120.
